the_counter.speaker: BB
the_counter.text: Ben! Thank the peel you’re awake!

the_counter.speaker: Ben
the_counter.text: BB, where is she? Her rind is on the floor.

the_counter.speaker: BB
the_counter.text: They’re locking down the Cabinet Borders. You need to run!

the_counter.speaker: Ben
the_counter.text: I found a green shaving. Did the vegetables take her?

the_counter.speaker: BB
the_counter.text: Don't ask questions you can't digest. Just move!

party_store.speaker: Blerk
party_store.text: Whoa, peel back, man. You look bruised.

party_store.speaker: Blerk
party_store.text: Yeah, looking at streamers. Didn't buy anything.

party_store.speaker: Blerk
party_store.text: Left with some rough-looking greens. Real fibrous types.

party_store.speaker: Ben
party_store.text: Point me to the crisper. Now.

veggie_court_aggressive.speaker: Ben
veggie_court_aggressive.text: Where's my wife, Brockingi? I know your roots took her.

veggie_court_aggressive.speaker: King Brockingi
veggie_court_aggressive.text: You march into my dirt and accuse the crown?

veggie_court_aggressive.speaker: Ben
veggie_court_aggressive.text: I found your shavings at the scene. Don't lie.

veggie_court_aggressive.speaker: King Brockingi
veggie_court_aggressive.text: Guards, toss this rot out. And ready the catapults.

veggie_court_diplomatic.speaker: Ben
veggie_court_diplomatic.text: Your Highness. I found this shaving where my wife vanished.

veggie_court_diplomatic.speaker: King Brockingi
veggie_court_diplomatic.text: Hmm. A rough cut. Sloppy edge work.

veggie_court_diplomatic.speaker: King Brockingi
veggie_court_diplomatic.text: That's Carl's handiwork. Check the plumbing, fruit.

the_fridge.speaker: Ben
the_fridge.text: Talk, dairy. Where did she go?

the_fridge.speaker: Milk Carton
the_fridge.text: The ice... she just wanted ice...

the_fridge.speaker: Milk Carton
the_fridge.text: Nobody. She walked right into the warzone.

the_fridge.speaker: Milk Carton
the_fridge.text: The Cans and the Eggs. They're cracking shells in the Pantry.

pantry_tragic.speaker: Gina
pantry_tragic.text: Ben! You made it! Get down, the Cans are-

pantry_tragic.speaker: Ben
pantry_tragic.text: Drop the act, Gina. Darcey told me everything.

pantry_tragic.speaker: Gina
pantry_tragic.text: Darcey? Ben, what are you talking about? We need to hide!

pantry_tragic.speaker: Ben
pantry_tragic.text: Is that what you told Carl? Before you wrote him that song?

pantry_tragic.speaker: Gina
pantry_tragic.text: The song? Ben, I was trying to fix th-

pantry_tragic.speaker: Ben
pantry_tragic.text: I read the lyrics! You left me for a root vegetable!

pantry_tragic.speaker: Gina
pantry_tragic.text: Put the umbrella down, Ben. You're scaring me.

pantry_tragic.speaker: Ben
pantry_tragic.text: I'm not the one you should be scared of.
